import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nces_digest_college_enrollment_recent_graduates.xlsx', sheet_name='Digest 2023 Table 302.10', header=None)
data = df[pd.to_numeric(df[0], errors='coerce').notnull()].copy()

subset = data[(data[0] >= 2010) & (data[0] <= 2022)].copy()
# Column H is index 7 (Total percent enrolled in college)
subset[7] = pd.to_numeric(subset[7])
best_year = subset.loc[subset[7].idxmax(), 0]
result = str(int(best_year))
